messages:
Alex Chen: Quick async check — SprintGate status for this quarter. Short ask: call out what actually shipped, what slipped, and immediate next steps. Please be terse. @Priya @Marco @Jess
Priya Nair: Shipped: runtime v2 canary (internal), docs update, embedding inference benchmark. Perf looks stable :tada:
Marco Alvarez: Slipped: autoscaler rollout for dedicated pools — blocked on infra change in `autoscale-controller` (PR #452). ETA Wed. Also CR pending for batching change (needs perf signoff).
Jess Li: UI rollout postponed — depends on backend flagging API (blocked on Marco's infra change). I can hold the frontend canary until autoscaler is green.
Samir Patel: For prioritization: runtime canary -> good. Autoscaler is the main risk to Dedicated SLA OKR. Are there temporary mitigations we can enable?
Priya Nair: We can enable short-lived capacity buffer and revert to cheap fallback model variant on high tail latency. Need infra approval to bump buffer.
Marco Alvarez: Confirmed I have an infra PR but need a small DB migration window; target Wed 03:00-04:00 UTC. If we miss that, fallback will be active for next release.
Alex Chen: Action items: 1) Marco — finish infra PR + confirm migration window (owner). 2) Priya — prepare fallback rollout plan + smoke tests (owner). 3) Jess — hold UI canary until Marco green or provide degraded UX. 4) Samir — note to PMs and CS about potential short fallback.
Jess Li: Acked. I'll tag frontend reviewers and add a tiny UX warning for degraded mode.
Priya Nair: Adding smoke test matrix now. Quick snippet for canary test runner:
```bash
# run canary smoke
./ci/run_smoke.sh --target runtime-v2 --samples 100 --latency-threshold 120
```
Alex Chen: CR pings: Marco, can you please review @eng-runtime's batching CR? It's blocking perf signoff. Jess will need the API stub merged to test.
Marco Alvarez: On it. Pinged in the CR thread. If reviewers don't show, I'll merge under feature-flag and revert if problems.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime-v2-canary -> infra-stage (id: dpl_789). ETA 15m.
Samir Patel: Thanks all. I'll update the OKR spreadsheet with shipped/slipped and list the mitigations. If anyone needs me to escalate to infra-ops, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Closing ask — short follow-ups only after you update your owners above. Cheers.
